# Uncle Abe

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 XIV A Danger Averted P9](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0009), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P6](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0006), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P48](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0048)</sub>
- **Role:** weather prophet  <sub>[v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P3](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0003)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

_Not yet known._

## Personality

Uncle Abe is a persistent weather prognosticator who continues to make predictions despite a history of inaccurate forecasts. Nevertheless, he has demonstrated the ability to occasionally hit upon the exact day when foretelling rain.

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P9](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0009), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P46](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0046), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P17](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0017)_

## Traits

- persistent prophet of weather despite inaccurate predictions  <sub>[v2 XIV A Danger Averted P9](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0009)</sub>

## Abilities

- predicting rain  <sub>[v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P46](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0046), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P17](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0017)</sub>

## Goals

_Not yet known._

## History

Uncle Abe accurately predicted a violent storm that hit [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) with devastating force. The resulting tempest brought heavy hail, caused widespread damage to local crops and property, and killed Mr. Harrison's parrot.

_Sources: [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P24](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0024), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P25](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0025), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P43](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0043), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P54](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0054)_
